Direction_Note: Negative: larger ground clearance → lower capacitance
Physical_Context: Distance from pair to ground plane. Larger clearance reduces image-charge effect, decreasing total capacitance. No significant effect on mutual inductance (hence excluded from mut model).

Direction_Note: Negative: larger separation → lower inter-wire capacitance
Physical_Context: Wire-to-wire centre distance. Larger separation reduces mutual inductive coupling (decreasing M) and reduces inter-wire capacitance (decreasing C). Dominant control parameter for both EMC properties.

Direction_Note: Moderate: twist pitch affects effective wire geometry
Physical_Context: Twist pitch of the pair. Shorter pitch improves field cancellation, reducing effective mutual inductance. Has moderate effect on capacitance through wire spacing geometry.
